acceptance: mark-implementation-reviewed on a leaf's feature branch, in an interactive terminal without --yes, when counted reviewer blocks are why the gate is not met: before anything is written, and before the menu, it runs the trial merge, the clean-tree check (work/ excepted), the M22.51 role check (role_refusal), the git identity check, then with a remote a fetch of the integration branch and a fresh gate evaluation at the fetched tip (a failed fetch refuses), or with no remote the check that a worktree holding the integration branch has no uncommitted tracked changes, then checks on that gate that settling every counted block, and the shortfall unless signed_reviews is on, would pass it (so a policy pin, an unmet strong_review item or a signed-review shortfall withholds the option). Only then it prints each blocking record's findings, offers [a] Approve over the block and reads the reason in the person's own words (empty reason or q: exit 0, nothing recorded). It records the M22.51 operator decision (closed kind: decision entry, decided_by: operator, answer naming the full commit, each block with its findings, any shortfall, the reason as the quote and the git user as recorder) through one function shared with review operator-decision that only appends the entry to the ledger in the root it is given; the caller writes the OPERATOR-<commit>.yaml marker in the checkout running the command, only after the push or ref move succeeds. It then commits the registry approval, in one command

The decision commit is made in a detached temporary worktree of the integration tip the gate read and changes only the project-relative roadmap/decisions.yaml (<prefix>roadmap/decisions.yaml for a project under the git root, such as sr/); never on the leaf branch. With a remote it is pushed as HEAD:refs/heads/<integration>; a refused push leaves no marker and no ledger change. With no remote the local branch moves by compare-and-swap from that tip and a holding worktree follows it. nested_repos_land.py gains two public steps, a temporary worktree that runs a callback and the compare-and-swap ref move with _follow_in_checkout; _merge_in_temp_tree is not shared, the feature-branch merge stays in _land_one and _land_one_locally, and nested landing's behaviour and tests are unchanged. No checkout's branch changes; with a remote the coordinator checkout's HEAD and status are unchanged. Stdout names the pushed or moved integration commit. The gate is then re-evaluated and passes, the registry is stamped, and finish-this-task lands the leaf
